req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* is present on ALL responses. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) assert the exact header value '*' not just presence; (2) test multiple endpoints to confirm the header is universal; (3) test that the header key name is exactly 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin'; (4) test with various HTTP methods; (5) test error responses (4xx) also carry the header; (6) boundary-test the wildcard value vs a specific origin to confirm '*' is used and not something else.

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_and_exact_on_get
actions: Import app via from httpbin.core import app
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_present_and_exact_on_get():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in r.headers
    assert r.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*'

test_cors_header_present_and_exact_on_get()

tests.name: test_cors_header_exact_value_not_empty_or_null
actions: Check header value is exactly '*' not '' or 'null' or 'None'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_exact_value_not_empty_or_null():
    r = client.get('/headers')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert val is not None
    assert val == '*'
    assert val != ''
    assert val != 'null'
    assert len(val) == 1

test_cors_header_exact_value_not_empty_or_null()

tests.name: test_cors_header_absent_or_wrong_value_fails
actions: Verify header is NOT a specific origin like 'https://evil.com'
expected: Value is '*' not a specific domain
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_absent_or_wrong_value_fails():
    r = client.get('/get')
    val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert val is not None, 'CORS header must be present'
    assert val != 'https://evil.com'
    assert val != 'null'
    assert val != 'false'
    assert val == '*'

test_cors_header_absent_or_wrong_value_fails()

tests.name: test_cors_header_key_case_insensitive_exact_name
actions: Check header using exact canonical name and lowercase variant
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_key_case_insensitive_exact_name():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    # Flask/Werkzeug headers are case-insensitive; test both casings
    assert r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin') == '*'
    assert r.headers.get('access-control-allow-origin') == '*'
    # Ensure it is NOT a different CORS header
    assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in r.headers

test_cors_header_key_case_insensitive_exact_name()

tests.name: test_cors_header_wildcard_not_specific_origin
actions: Send GET /get with Origin header set to a specific domain
Verify response still returns '*' not the echoed origin
expected: Not equal to the sent Origin value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_wildcard_not_specific_origin():
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Origin': 'https://example.com'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert val == '*'
    assert val != 'https://example.com'

test_cors_header_wildcard_not_specific_origin()
